column2: Fictional cases. Review ESI and awareness before arrival.
Purav Patel
Hospitalist
This is a single review with no follow-up round. Fill the yellow fields for every case. The Attention exercise and Form Feedback tabs are optional.

Read the earlier report, then the latest (T=0). Use only supplied facts. Missing information does not mean normal; flag important gaps. Answer for the report as written; note anything unrealistic for an EMS crew on the Form Feedback tab.
Judge meaningful change separately from ESI level. Improvement can count too. Select No earlier report when none is provided. Direction is optional.

Choose 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or Cannot assess. Use ESI (ENA handbook, 5th edition) to estimate the level from the latest EMS report for clinician confirmation. In ESI reason / limits, name the decision point and supporting reported facts. Cannot assess means there is too little reliable information to assign a level. Keep ESI separate from the 1–10 risk score.

EMS to ED Handoff: in 2–3 sentences, what you would want to hear before arrival.
Mark each case Done, or Question for team if something stops you answering.
